title: Strings, Prompt Templates & Token Estimation
why: LLMs operate entirely on text and tokens. Mastering Python f-strings, string formatting, multiline prompts, and character-to-token heuristics is essential for constructing reliable prompts without overflowing context windows.
objectives: Format multi-line system prompts with f-strings
Sanitize user inputs to prevent accidental prompt injection
Estimate tokens using the 1 token ~= 4 characters rule
concept: Prompts are dynamically composed by injecting user queries, retrieved RAG context, and available tool descriptions. Clean string manipulation ensures clear boundary delimiters between system instructions and untrusted user input.

code.content:
def build_system_prompt(role: str, user_input: str, context: str = '') -> str:
    """Constructs safe structured prompt for LLM consumption."""
    # Sanitize inputs by stripping dangling delimiters
    cleaned_input = user_input.strip()
    
    prompt = f"""### SYSTEM INSTRUCTIONS
You are an AI assistant specialized in: {role}.

### RETRIEVED CONTEXT
{context or 'No external context provided.'}

### USER QUERY
{cleaned_input}

### ASSISTANT RESPONSE:
"""
    return prompt

def estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    # General heuristic: ~4 characters per token in English
    return max(1, len(text) // 4)

query = 'How do autonomous agents plan actions?'
p = build_system_prompt('AI Architect', query, 'Agents use ReAct cycles.')
print(p)
print(f'Estimated Tokens: {estimate_tokens(p)}')

practice.description: Write a prompt formatter that takes a list of tool names and descriptions and renders a bulleted markdown string for the system prompt.
practice.hint: Use '\n'.join([f'- {t}: {d}' for t, d in tools.items()])

requirements: Accept a maximum token limit (e.g. 2000 tokens)
Truncate the oldest context messages if total estimated tokens exceed the limit

checklist: Used f-strings with multiline docstrings cleanly
mistakes: Concatenating strings with + repeatedly in loops instead of join()
Hardcoding raw user input directly into system instructions without separation delimiters
